report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with durations 78-203ms; no errors, timeouts, or 5xx appear in traces or metrics (checkout 502 count is 0). The 230ms p95 is not clearly anomalous without a baseline. No current evidence substantiates any taxonomy cause, so no candidate is asserted; dependency-level metrics and logs are required to bound a cause or rule out alternatives.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency/error metrics for order->inventory, order->payment, order->postgresql, inventory->redis
Baseline comparison of checkout p95 latency to confirm whether 230ms is anomalous
Error or timeout logs from order, payment, inventory, or redis during the window
Postgres connection pool saturation metrics (wait time, active vs max connections)
